## Which tours visit Laguna Cañapa?

Our selection features {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. They all visit [Laguna Cañapa](/bolivia/place/laguna-canapa/), one of the high-altitude lakes of southwestern Bolivia. Their duration, order of stops and geographical scope, however, vary considerably: there are three-day 4WD routes through colorful lagoons, 10–12-day journeys across several Bolivian regions, and itineraries combining the Altiplano with Argentina and Chile.

**If seeing the lagoons and the Uyuni Salt Flat is your main goal, start with a short 4WD tour.** For a broader introduction to Bolivia, you can add La Paz, Lake Titicaca and historic cities. On a multi-country journey, the lagoons become one of several natural highlights alongside Patagonia's glaciers or cities.

It is important to distinguish an itinerary that actually visits Cañapa from one that simply advertises the “colorful lagoons of Bolivia.” A stop at [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/) or [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) does not, by itself, establish that Cañapa is included. The routes gathered here specifically visit Cañapa.

## Comparing itineraries that visit Cañapa

| Tour | Main distinguishing feature |
|---|---|
| [3-day Uyuni 4WD tour](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-uyuni-salt-flats-jeep-tour-3-days/) | Lagoons, volcanoes and desert |
| [Bolivia in 11 days](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-titicaca-uyuni-la-paz-11-days/) | Titicaca, La Paz and Uyuni |
| [Natural Wonders of Bolivia](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-natural-wonders-10-days/) | A broader nature-focused route |
| [Patagonia and Uyuni, 12 days](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-uyuni-salt-flats-12-days/) | Argentina, Chile and Bolivia |

On the [3-day 4WD tour](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-uyuni-salt-flats-jeep-tour-3-days/), Cañapa is visited on the second day along with [Laguna Honda](/bolivia/place/laguna-honda/) and [Laguna Hedionda](/bolivia/place/laguna-hedionda/). The route then crosses the [Siloli Desert](/bolivia/place/siloli-desert/) toward the [Stone Tree](/bolivia/place/arbol-de-piedra/) and [Ollagüe Volcano](/bolivia/place/ollague-volcano/). Of the options listed, this one focuses most closely on natural landmarks: you cover much of the route by off-road vehicle in a short time.

On the [11-day journey through Bolivia](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-titicaca-uyuni-la-paz-11-days/), the lagoons form part of a larger itinerary. Day six combines [Uyuni](/bolivia/place/uyuni/), [Incahuasi](/bolivia/place/incahuasi-island/), Cañapa, Hedionda and Honda. Earlier, travelers explore [La Paz](/bolivia/place/la-paz/) and [Lake Titicaca](/bolivia/place/lake-titicaca-bolivia/); later, the route continues through other parts of the country. This tour suits those who want to add culture and history to the landscapes of the Altiplano.

The [Natural Wonders of Bolivia itinerary](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-natural-wonders-10-days/) also connects Cañapa with other natural stops. When choosing, it is worth reading the complete day-by-day itinerary: the tour's name indicates its theme, but the sequence of overnight stays and drives determines the pace.

The [12-day Patagonia and Uyuni tour](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-uyuni-salt-flats-12-days/) combines Bolivia's highlands with Argentina and Chile. For travelers who enjoy contrasting scenery, it offers an opportunity to see glaciers and lagoons on the same holiday. A multi-country itinerary does involve more transfers, however, so the time allocated to each lake should be considered separately.

## Why Cañapa is visited alongside other lagoons

Laguna Cañapa lies in the Nor Lípez area at an altitude of approximately 4,140 m. It is part of a group of saline high-altitude lakes surrounded by the dry slopes of the Andes. The water can appear blue-green, while the pale mineral shores contrast sharply with the reddish and ochre mountains around them. Changes in light can make the same landscape look quite different.

Birdlife is a major reason to stop here. Andean, Chilean and James's flamingos inhabit the saline lakes of the Altiplano. However, **the name of a lagoon alone cannot guarantee a bird sighting**: where birds gather and how many are present depend on the season and water conditions. The excursion schedule also needs to allow time for watching them, rather than merely a quick roadside photograph.

Nearby are [Laguna Hedionda](/bolivia/place/laguna-hedionda/) and [Laguna Honda](/bolivia/place/laguna-honda/), which can conveniently be visited in one 4WD circuit. Farther along, the route may cross Siloli toward [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/) and the natural areas of the [Eduardo Avaroa Reserve](/bolivia/place/eduardo-avaroa-national-reserve/). These places share the geography of the Altiplano, but each has its own scenery; a photograph of red water does not represent Cañapa.

## On a 4WD route: how much time do you need at the lake?

Cañapa is usually one stop on an off-road expedition. The journey follows unpaved highland roads, with long distances between settlements. None of the itineraries considered here advertises a separate excursion involving an overnight stay solely at Cañapa.

The duration of the entire tour therefore matters more than an abstract question about how many hours to spend looking at the lagoon. On a short route, several lakes and volcanic landmarks are visited in a single day. A longer journey may devote several days to the region, but any particular lake may still be a brief stop along the way.

Before booking, compare:
- which day specifically includes Cañapa and which lakes come before and after it;
- where you will spend the night and how long the Altiplano section takes;
- whether local transport, a guide, meals and conservation fees, where applicable to the actual route, are included in the price;
- whether the journey continues to [San Pedro de Atacama](/chile/place/san-pedro-de-atacama/) or returns to [Uyuni](/bolivia/place/uyuni/).

Answers vary across itineraries and seasons. Prices, transport arrangements and the order of visits cannot automatically be copied from one journey to another simply because both pass through Cañapa.

## Weather, altitude and preparation

An altitude of more than 4,000 m can be felt even during short walks. If you arrive from a lowland city and head straight to the Altiplano, you need to take acclimatization and your own health into account. People with chronic medical conditions should discuss such travel plans with a doctor in advance. Even an easy walk at altitude may feel harder than usual.

Daytime sunshine can be intense, with strong winds, while evenings turn cold quickly. Dressing in layers and bringing sun protection is advisable. Dusty stretches of unpaved road also require adequate time and suitable transport.

The drier period generally runs from May to October. During the rainy season some roads may become more difficult, and the lakes and salt flat change in appearance. Actual access to individual stops should be assessed for the route and date concerned, without promising constant road conditions or a guaranteed encounter with flamingos.

If wildlife and landscapes are your main interests, compare [nature and wildlife tours in Bolivia](/interests/wildlife/tours/bolivia/). If you want to spend several days exploring the Altiplano by 4WD, see the [adventure tours in Bolivia](/interests/adventure/tours/bolivia/).

## How to choose a tour visiting Cañapa

With 3–4 days available, it makes sense to consider the [Uyuni 4WD itinerary](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-uyuni-salt-flats-jeep-tour-3-days/) and compare it with trips to neighboring lakes. With 10–12 days, you can choose a journey featuring La Paz, Titicaca and other regions. To visit several countries in one trip, compare [combined South America itineraries](/multi-country/), taking a close look at the Bolivian portion.

Make a short list of the experiences you would not want to miss: Cañapa and flamingos, the Uyuni Salt Flat, Laguna Colorada, deserts or Patagonia. Then open the actual itineraries and compare the days rather than choosing solely by the most beautiful photograph.

## Frequently asked questions about Laguna Cañapa

### Can you see flamingos at Cañapa?

It is one of their habitats on Bolivia's Altiplano. Their presence and location depend on natural conditions, however, so sightings cannot be guaranteed for any particular date.

### Is Cañapa included in the three-day Uyuni 4WD tour?

Yes. On the [3-day tour](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-uyuni-salt-flats-jeep-tour-3-days/), it is visited on day two along with lakes Honda and Hedionda.

### Can Cañapa and Lake Titicaca be visited on the same trip?

Yes. The [11-day Bolivia itinerary](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-titicaca-uyuni-la-paz-11-days/) connects both parts of the country, with separate transfers and other excursions between them.

### Are Laguna Cañapa and Laguna Colorada the same lake?

No. They are separate natural landmarks. Cañapa belongs to the Nor Lípez group of lagoons; [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/) is known for its reddish water and lies farther south.

### Do you need a full day at Cañapa?

In the tours covered here, it is a stop within a 4WD itinerary through several lakes. If you want more time for birdwatching and photography, changes to the schedule should be discussed for the specific itinerary.

## Laguna Chalviri: a high-altitude lake and the Polques hot springs

[Laguna Chalviri](/bolivia/place/laguna-chalviri/) (Laguna Chalviri, Salar de Chalviri) lies in southwestern [Bolivia](/bolivia/), along a highland route through the [Eduardo Avaroa Reserve](/bolivia/place/eduardo-avaroa-national-reserve/). It is a mineral lake surrounded by the dry mountain plains of the Altiplano. A visit is often paired with a stop at the **Polques hot springs**, where visitors can bathe in a separate pool of warm geothermal water.

There is an important distinction: **Laguna Chalviri and the Polques thermal bathing pools are not the same body of water**. Visitors see the lagoon as a natural landmark, while bathing takes place in a specially used area of the hot springs. If an itinerary lists “Chalviri,” check whether it includes swimming or only a stop by the lake.

## What makes Laguna Chalviri interesting?

Southwestern Bolivia is known for its colorful lagoons, salt flats, volcanic landforms and geyser fields. Chalviri reveals another side of this landscape: an open, flat expanse of water, mineral-rich shores, distant mountains and cold high-altitude air.

Unlike [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), recognizable for its reddish water and visiting flamingos, Chalviri is notable for the combination of a saline lake environment and geothermal activity in the neighboring Polques area. [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) is known for its greenish color and nearby volcanic slopes. In photographs these stops can appear similar because of their open skies and mountains, but they have different natural features and their own separate pages.

Chalviri is situated more than 4,000 m above sea level. Visits take place in thin air, under strong sunshine and sometimes cold winds. Even a short stop calls for warm clothing and protection from ultraviolet radiation.

## Where are the Polques hot springs?

The [Polques hot springs](/bolivia/place/polques-hot-springs/) are located in the Chalviri area. Their water is heated by geothermal processes. For travelers, the most memorable part is the opportunity to sit in warm water amid barren highland mountains while the air temperature is considerably lower.

There are three things to keep in mind when bathing:

- **Water temperature and conditions.** Enter the pool gradually and pay attention to how you feel, as the contrast between warm water and cold air can be sharp.
- **Altitude.** Even gentle movement can cause breathlessness on the Altiplano; after a long drive, avoid rushing or overheating.
- **Access conditions.** Stop duration, the state of the pools and whether bathing is possible depend on current local arrangements and the itinerary.

Do not assume you can swim in the lagoon itself as you would in a thermal pool. The natural mineral water and the designated bathing area have different purposes. A towel, footwear suitable for wet surfaces and dry warm clothes for afterward are useful.

## How Chalviri fits into a trip around Bolivia

The lagoon is rarely the sole destination of a multi-day trip from La Paz. It is usually visited with other natural sights of the southern Altiplano, often as part of an overnight 4WD itinerary.

On [Ada Tours' 14-day Peru, Bolivia and Chile journey](/multi-country/tour/south-america-peru-bolivia-chile-easter-island/), Chalviri is included on **day 11**. After spending the night in the Ojo de Perdiz area, travelers head for [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), [Sol de Mañana](/bolivia/place/sol-de-manana-geysers/) and then Chalviri. There is an opportunity to bathe in the hot springs. The route continues to [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/), then crosses the border to San Pedro de Atacama in Chile.

This sequence brings together natural landmarks with very different characteristics in a single day: a red lagoon, a geothermal field, hot springs and a green lagoon. **Each is a separate stop**, however. Chalviri is not another name for Sol de Mañana, nor does Polques refer to the entire lagoon.

Other highland itineraries include similar thermal stops. For example, the [12-day Bolivia tour](/bolivia/tour/bolivia-treasures-12-days/) includes bathing at Polques during a full day exploring the Siloli Desert and lagoons. The precise arrangements for that tour should be read in its own description: a stop at Polques does not imply the same overnight stays, road sequence or included services on another route.

## Preparing for a stop at Chalviri

You will need clothing that protects against cold winds, sunglasses, a hat and drinking water. At altitude, skin and eyes are exposed to intense sunlight even in cool weather. Early mornings and evenings can be particularly cold.

Three considerations matter when planning: some roads cross remote terrain; rainfall can change the condition of unpaved routes; and your well-being at altitude matters more than trying to visit every viewpoint. Acclimatization should be considered before reaching areas above 4,000 m. A severe headache, unusual weakness, loss of coordination or shortness of breath at rest requires medical assessment and help rather than continuing uphill to stay on schedule.

The season also changes the scenery: water levels, mineral deposits, light and road conditions can vary. A photograph taken in one month is no guarantee of the same appearance on another date.

## Chalviri, Colorada or Verde: which to choose?

| Lake | Main characteristic |
|---|---|
| Chalviri | Mineral shores, with Polques nearby |
| Colorada | Reddish water and flamingos |
| Verde | Greenish water and a volcano |

If time is limited, the better approach is not to choose the single “most beautiful” lagoon from a picture, but to check how the stops lie along the route. In the southern Altiplano, arranging a continuous journey with suitable transport is generally more practical than returning north after each excursion.

Explore your options in the [Bolivia tours catalog](/bolivia/tour/) and the [country's natural attractions catalog](/bolivia/place/).

## Frequently asked questions about Laguna Chalviri

### Can you swim in Laguna Chalviri?

Tourist bathing is primarily associated with **the Polques thermal pools near the lagoon**, rather than entering the natural mineral lake wherever you like. Access conditions should be confirmed with the organizer.

### How high is Chalviri?

This is a high-altitude area of the Altiplano, more than 4,000 m above sea level. The exact elevation depends on the point on the route; acclimatization remains important throughout the trip.

### What else is visited on the same day?

On the [14-day Ada Tours journey](/multi-country/tour/south-america-peru-bolivia-chile-easter-island/), the same day includes [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), the [Sol de Mañana geysers](/bolivia/place/sol-de-manana-geysers/) and [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) before the route continues into Chile.

### Is it worth coming solely for the hot springs?

A long trip just to visit one pool can take considerable time. It makes sense to combine Chalviri with the lagoons and geothermal sights of southwestern Bolivia, accounting for the long unpaved drives and the altitude.

## Which tours include Lake Chalviri?

Our catalog includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} that visit [Lake Chalviri](/bolivia/place/laguna-chalviri/) on their **main itinerary**: the [14-day South America grand tour](/multi-country/tour/south-america-peru-bolivia-chile-easter-island/) and a [33-day VIP journey](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/). In both cases Chalviri is a natural stop on a lengthy route, not a separate lakeside resort with accommodation.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_source_velikij_tur_po_yuzhnoj_amerike,tour_south_america_luxury_33_days}}

| Itinerary | Visit to Chalviri |
|---|---|
| 14 days | Day 11, before Chile |
| 33 days | Day 17, Altiplano lagoons |

The main difference lies in the scope of the journey and what happens on the other days. The shorter version, compared with the 33-day trip, connects the historic sights of Peru, high-altitude Bolivia and Chile in sequence. The longer VIP itinerary covers many more regions. The word VIP does not itself guarantee a private pool, personal transportation on every excursion or the absence of other visitors at the lake. Such arrangements are established only by the details of the individual tour.

## Day 11 of the 14-day journey

On day 11 of the [14-day tour](/multi-country/tour/south-america-peru-bolivia-chile-easter-island/), the route passes [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), known for reddish water and flamingos. Travelers then head to the [Sol de Mañana geysers](/bolivia/place/sol-de-manana-geysers/), where hot mud and steam rising from the ground can be seen.

The group then arrives at Lake Chalviri. **The itinerary explicitly offers an opportunity to bathe in the hot springs.** Afterward the journey continues to [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) and onward to [San Pedro de Atacama](/chile/place/san-pedro-de-atacama/). In one day, high-altitude lakes, a thermal area and a border crossing follow one another. The precise duration of the waterside stop is not specified.

This option suits travelers who want to combine a thermal bath on the Altiplano with other major sights in Bolivia as part of an organized multi-day journey.

## Day 17 of the 33-day tour

On the [33-day itinerary](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/), the lake appears on day 17. The schedule includes a standalone [excursion through the Altiplano lagoons](/bolivia/uyuni/altiplano-lagoons-chalviri-chile-border/). It connects [Chiar Khota](/bolivia/place/laguna-chiar-khota-potosi/), [Hedionda](/bolivia/place/laguna-hedionda/), [Cañapa](/bolivia/place/laguna-canapa/), [Honda](/bolivia/place/laguna-honda/) and Ramaditas. Travelers then visit [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/) and the Sol de Mañana geothermal area, stop at the hot springs near Chalviri and cross into Chile.

The excursion confirms a visit to the springs but **does not specify how much time is available for bathing**. It also gives no separate price for access to the bathing pools. The terms of the 14-day trip therefore cannot simply be applied to the 33-day itinerary.

The longer journey does offer a whole chain of different lagoons rather than just one lake. It appeals to travelers who want to observe the contrasting colors of the water, dry mountains, pale shores and places where Andean wildlife can be seen.

## How Chalviri differs from Polques and Sol de Mañana

“Lake Chalviri” refers to the high-altitude body of water and its surrounding area. The nearby thermal bathing facilities are generally called the [Polques hot springs](/bolivia/place/polques-hot-springs/). Travel itineraries may mention these names together, but it is worth distinguishing a visit to the lagoon, a stop at the springs and actual bathing, when expressly included.

[Sol de Mañana](/bolivia/place/sol-de-manana-geysers/) is another location. Visitors there see vents releasing hot steam and bubbling mud pools. This geothermal area is for sightseeing, not bathing. The single-day sequence “Colorada – Sol de Mañana – Chalviri” offers three distinct natural experiences.

The surrounding landscape is almost treeless. Wind and chilly air are noticeable even on sunny days, so warm clothes, sun protection and a dry change of clothing after the thermal water are useful. Exact stop times depend on the route's logistics and road conditions.

## Choosing the right tour

The **14-day itinerary** makes more sense if your main objective is to combine Peru, Bolivia and Chile within a more limited period. In addition to Chalviri, it includes major Andean landmarks, the [Uyuni Salt Flat](/bolivia/place/uyuni/) and high-altitude lagoons. The lake appears near the end of the Bolivian portion.

The **33-day itinerary** is suited to an extended journey with many more regions and excursions. Chalviri remains one episode among numerous experiences; choosing this journey simply for a few hours at the springs would make little sense without an interest in the rest of the itinerary.

If you would rather focus on Bolivian nature, compare [nature-focused tours of Bolivia](/interests/wildlife/tours/bolivia/) with the [general Bolivia tours catalog](/bolivia/tour/). A visit to Chalviri is not automatically included in every tour mentioning Uyuni.

## Practical aspects of the route

The southwestern Altiplano is high-altitude terrain with open plains and long road journeys. Prepare for cool winds, strong sunlight and shifts between very different temperatures. Those sensitive to altitude should consider their acclimatization schedule in advance and consult a doctor if necessary.

Both tours leave Bolivia for Chile overland. It is therefore best to see Chalviri as part of a full day of natural sights and a border crossing, rather than a place where you can spend unlimited time. Neither description guarantees an exact arrival time at the lagoon.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which tour explicitly includes bathing at the springs?

The [14-day itinerary](/multi-country/tour/south-america-peru-bolivia-chile-easter-island/) states that visitors can bathe in hot springs near Chalviri. The [33-day itinerary](/multi-country/tour/south-america-luxury-33-days/) includes a stop at the springs; the duration of bathing and any separate conditions are not specified.

### Can you visit Chalviri without Laguna Colorada?

Both itineraries considered here include both stops. Other road itineraries in the region may differ. When booking, the published list of places on the particular tour matters more than a general list of Altiplano attractions.

### How long is the stop at the lake?

The exact duration of the Chalviri visit is not specified in the available descriptions of the two tours. Other lagoons, geysers and the drive toward the Chilean border also occupy this day, so the length of the entire excursion should not be confused with time spent at the lake.

### What else can you see nearby?

Depending on the itinerary, nearby attractions include [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), [Sol de Mañana](/bolivia/place/sol-de-manana-geysers/), [Laguna Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) and the [Eduardo Avaroa Reserve](/bolivia/place/eduardo-avaroa-national-reserve/). Comparing the actual sequence of stops is more useful than looking only at names on a map.

## Laguna Chiar Khota: an Altiplano lake on the way to Uyuni

**Laguna Chiar Khota (Chiar Kkota)** lies in the high-altitude part of Bolivia's Potosí Department. It is one of the lakes of the southwestern Altiplano, along routes through lagoons, salt flats and volcanic slopes. Laguna Hedionda and [Laguna Cañapa](/bolivia/place/laguna-canapa/) are nearby; the entire area is characterized by dry highland scenery.

The name has several variants: Chiar Khota, Chiar Kkota, Ch'iyar Quta and the Russian form Chiarkota. Some maps also use Laguna Negra. The **precise geographical context** matters: this is the lake in Potosí on the route toward Uyuni, not another similarly named lake near mountain trails in the La Paz region.

Chiar Khota is less widely known than [Laguna Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/), but it helps reveal the diversity of high-altitude lakes. Instead of a striking red surface, visitors may see more muted bluish, gray-green and silvery shades that change with the wind and light.

## How Chiar Khota differs from other lagoons

Chiar Khota is a shallow high-altitude lake among open plains and dry mountains. Small changes in the weather greatly affect the view from the shore: in still conditions the surface reflects the sky, while wind creates ripples and makes the color appear darker. Mineral deposits and stony banks are visible in some places.

It helps travelers distinguish the lakes by their defining features:

| Lake | Main distinguishing feature |
|---|---|
| Chiar Khota | Peaceful high-altitude views |
| [Colorada](/bolivia/place/laguna-colorada/) | Reddish water and flamingos |
| [Verde](/bolivia/place/laguna-verde/) | Licancabur Volcano and greenish water |
| [Cañapa](/bolivia/place/laguna-canapa/) | Another lagoon on the way to Uyuni |

These descriptions refer to characteristic landscapes, not guaranteed water colors or bird sightings at the time of an excursion.

## Birds and natural conditions

The wetlands of the southwestern Altiplano are important for high-altitude birds, including flamingos. At some lagoons, birds feed in shallow water where conditions support microorganisms that form the foundation of local food chains.

Flamingos **may be seen at Chiar Khota, but sightings are not guaranteed**. Birds move between neighboring lakes, so neither a particular flock nor a close-up photographic opportunity can be promised. Visitors should stay on permitted routes and avoid disturbing wildlife.

Water in these highland lagoons can be saline and mineral-rich. The shore should not be treated as a beach or swimming area. To protect local nature and account for ground conditions, it is better to remain within designated viewing areas.

## How Chiar Khota fits into a trip to Bolivia

The lagoon is visited on road journeys through the high-altitude lakes. It is generally a stop during a longer drive rather than a self-contained destination with urban facilities. Other lagoons lie nearby, and the journey may continue to [Uyuni](/bolivia/place/uyuni/) and the salt flat.

The current [12-day Ada Tours “Patagonia and Uyuni Salt Flat” itinerary](/multi-country/tour/patagonia-uyuni-salt-flats-12-days/) includes Chiar Khota on the Bolivian highland section, alongside Colorada and Cañapa. Chiar Khota is one of the colorful lagoons on this route toward Uyuni. The tour also visits Argentina and Chile; the lake stop forms part of a multi-day, multi-country journey.

If planning an independent trip, bear in mind that the lake may be spelled differently on maps and in descriptions. Agree with the driver not only on the name but also on the location relative to neighboring lagoons. Roads are unpaved here, and standard navigation estimates may not be reliable.

## Altitude, weather and preparation

The Chiar Khota area lies **at approximately 4,200 meters above sea level**. Even a brief stop takes place in thin air and intense sunlight. Temperature and wind can change noticeably; mornings and evenings can be cold despite clear skies.

Warm clothing, a hat, sunglasses, drinking water and wind protection are useful. People unaccustomed to altitude may experience headaches, weakness or nausea. If significant altitude-related symptoms occur, inform your companions and seek medical assistance; ignoring worsening symptoms to make another stop is dangerous.

As elsewhere on the Altiplano, the rainy season can affect unpaved road conditions. During dry weather, dust and wind pose their own challenges. Rather than searching for the “perfect hour” for a photograph, consider the order of all stops and the time needed to drive between them.

## Photographing the lagoon without disturbing nature

Chiar Khota's appeal is its open landscape: water, mineral-rich banks and mountain slopes. You do not always need to approach the water's edge for a good photograph. A more distant vantage point can better convey the lake's setting on the plateau, while watching from afar disturbs birds less.

Avoid approaching flamingos or other birds just to take close-up photographs, leaving litter or driving off approved roads to find a better camera angle. Any rules for protected sections and movement restrictions should be checked for the chosen route.

Chiar Khota is particularly rewarding on a journey that visits **several different lagoons**. The colors of the water, birdlife and geology become clearer when compared with Colorada, Verde and Cañapa. Farther on, the scenery of high-altitude Bolivia changes as you approach Uyuni.

## Frequently asked questions about Laguna Chiar Khota

### Where is Laguna Chiar Khota?

In the high-altitude Potosí Department of southwestern Bolivia, among the lagoons of the Altiplano. It lies near Laguna Hedionda and on routes toward Cañapa and Uyuni.

### What other names does Laguna Chiar Khota have?

Maps may use Chiar Khota, Chiar Kkota, Ch'iyar Quta or Laguna Negra. When searching, specify the lake in Potosí Department to avoid confusing it with similarly named mountain features.

### Can you see flamingos at Chiar Khota?

Flamingos inhabit the high-altitude lagoons of this region, including the area around Chiar Khota, but their presence depends on natural conditions. A sighting on a specific day cannot be guaranteed.

### Can Chiar Khota and the Uyuni Salt Flat be visited together?

Yes. Road itineraries through southwestern Bolivia visit several lagoons before continuing toward [Uyuni](/bolivia/place/uyuni/). Travel time and the order of stops depend on the overall itinerary and road conditions.

## Why the name Chiar Khota needs clarification

English- and Spanish-language sources use variants such as Chiar Khota, Chiarkota and other spellings. Moreover, the name Chiar Khota also refers to another high-altitude lake in the Cordillera Real area, closer to La Paz. This catalog specifically covers **the lagoon in southwestern Bolivia's Potosí Department**, which lies on the lake route near Uyuni.

This distinction matters when booking independent transport or searching for photographs: the same or similar name can point to a completely different destination. For the Ada Tours route, the correct reference is the sequence of lakes Cañapa, Hedionda, Chiar Khota and Honda.
